metadata.name: c_vault
metadata.description: c_vault v2.0.0 — On-chain multi-fund index vault (ETF-style) for Solana

instructions.name: claim
docs: Instruction 3 of 3 — send pending USDC to user and close RedeemState.

accounts.name: treasury_usdc_account
docs: Company's 20% redeem-fee slice destination — treasury's USDC ATA.

accounts.name: fee_recipient_usdc_account
docs: Vault manager's 80% redeem-fee slice destination — created idempotently
regardless of fee amount.

instructions.name: create_asset
docs: Admin-only: list a new global asset. Runs pool/TVL/ownership
validation once at listing time; vaults reference it by id afterward.

instructions.name: create_etf
docs: Create a new ETF fund vault, including its Token-2022 share metadata,
in a single transaction. The new vault's id is always
`global_state.total_vaults`; PDA seeds are derived from it directly. The
counter is incremented by 1 once the vault is initialised.

accounts.name: global_state
docs: Program-wide singleton — must already be initialised via init_global_state.
`total_vaults` is read here (pre-handler) to derive this vault's PDA seeds.

accounts.name: vault
docs: The new vault state PDA, keyed by the current global vault counter.

accounts.name: vault_authority
docs: Per-vault PDA that signs CPIs on behalf of this vault.

accounts.name: shares_mint
docs: Share (LP) token mint for this vault — Token-2022. Created manually in the
handler (not via Anchor's `init` + `mint::…` macro) because the
`MetadataPointer` extension must be initialized *before* `InitializeMint2`,
and this workspace's anchor-spl (0.31.0) doesn't yet support declaring
mint extensions through the account macro (added in 0.31.1).
mint (with MetadataPointer extension) in the handler below.

accounts.name: usdc_vault
docs: USDC token account custodied by this vault.

accounts.name: usdc_mint
docs: The USDC mint (base currency for all deposits and redemptions).

accounts.name: shares_token_program
docs: Token-2022 program — used for the share mint.

accounts.name: token_program
docs: Classic SPL Token program — used for the USDC vault account.

instructions.name: deposit
docs: Instruction A — transfer USDC, price shares against pre-swap NAV, mint shares.
Must be followed by per-asset swap legs in the same transaction. For
`Fixed` vaults near their max_shares cap, the deposit is clamped to
remaining headroom rather than rejected.

accounts.name: token_program
docs: Token-2022 program (for c_vault share mint / burn / transfers).

accounts.name: base_token_program
docs: Classic SPL Token program (for USDC transfers).

accounts.name: user_info
docs: One PDA per (vault, user) — created on this user's first deposit into
this vault, reused (accumulated) on every deposit after that.

accounts.name: treasury_usdc_account
docs: Company's 20% deposit-fee slice destination — treasury's USDC ATA.

accounts.name: fee_recipient_usdc_account
docs: Vault manager's 80% deposit-fee slice destination — vault's fee_recipient USDC ATA.

instructions.name: get_total_nav_view
docs: Read-only: returns live NAV, share price, and total shares.
Call with `.view()` from the TypeScript client — no wallet signature needed.

instructions.name: init_global_state
docs: Create the GlobalState singleton. Must be called once before any vault is created.

instructions.name: preview_deposit
docs: Read-only: shares a `usdc_amount` deposit would mint right now.
Call with `.view()` from the TypeScript client — no wallet signature needed.

instructions.name: preview_redeem
docs: Read-only: asset amounts + estimated USDC that burning `shares` would return.
Call with `.view()` from the TypeScript client — no wallet signature needed.

accounts.name: user_info
docs: The redeemer's UserInfo — read-only, used only to estimate the
profit-gated vault fee. Must already exist (same requirement as the
real `request_redeem`); a caller with no UserInfo would have their
real redeem rejected with `InsufficientTrackedBasis`.

accounts.name: user
docs: require the caller to sign, so any pubkey may be passed to preview any
user's redeem quote.

instructions.name: request_redeem
docs: Instruction 1 of 3 — burn shares, record proportional asset amounts, start 24hr cooldown.

accounts.name: user_info
docs: Must already exist — a user with no UserInfo has `shares_held == 0`
and can never pass the tracked-basis check below. Not `init_if_needed`.

accounts.name: token_program
docs: Token-2022 program (for c_vault share burn).

instructions.name: set_asset_active
docs: Admin-only: activate/deactivate a listed asset. Deactivation blocks
only *new* `create_etf` inclusion — existing vaults unaffected.

instructions.name: set_emergency
docs: Turn global emergency mode on or off (blocks new deposits program-wide).

instructions.name: set_fee_recipient
docs: Update the pubkey that receives accrued performance fees for this vault.

instructions.name: set_paused
docs: Pause or unpause deposits for this vault (withdrawals always remain open).

instructions.name: set_twap_keeper
docs: Admin-only: assign (or clear, via `Pubkey::default()`) the wallet
allowed to call `update_dex_twap`.

instructions.name: set_vault_emergency_lock
docs: Admin-only: lock or unlock deposits for a single vault (redemptions
always remain open). Independent of the vault manager's own
`set_paused`.

instructions.name: swap_asset_to_sol
docs: Instruction 2 of 3 (per-asset, ViaSol leg 1) — swap one asset slot → wSOL.
The input amount is read from `RedeemState.asset_amount_in[asset_index]`.
Follow with `swap_sol_to_usdc` to finish converting the wSOL to USDC.

instructions.name: swap_asset_to_usdc
docs: Instruction 2 of 3 (per-asset) — after cooldown, swap one asset slot → USDC
directly (DirectUsdc route). The input amount is read from
`RedeemState.asset_amount_in[asset_index]`; net USDC is accumulated into
`pending_usdc`. Call once per DirectUsdc asset before `claim`.

instructions.name: swap_sol_to_asset
docs: Permissionless: deploy the vault's pending wSOL into one ViaSol asset.
Amount = total_pending_sol × sol_target_bps[idx] / 10_000; no-ops if 0.

accounts.name: signer
docs: Permissionless caller — any signer may deploy pending wSOL.

instructions.name: swap_sol_to_usdc
docs: Instruction 2 of 3 (per-asset, ViaSol leg 2) — swap accumulated wSOL → USDC
for `asset_index`, deduct the performance fee, and accumulate net USDC into
`pending_usdc`. `wsol_amount` is the wSOL produced by the prior
`swap_asset_to_sol` leg (a runtime value, not the stored asset amount).

accounts.name: token_program_a
docs: Token program for mint A (owner of `token_mint_a`).

accounts.name: token_program_b
docs: Token program for mint B (owner of `token_mint_b`).

instructions.name: swap_usdc_to_asset
docs: Permissionless: deploy the vault's pending USDC into one DirectUsdc asset.
Amount is derived on-chain from `vault.usdc_target_amount[idx]`; no-ops if 0.

accounts.name: signer
docs: Permissionless caller — pays tx fees; any signer may deploy pending funds.

instructions.name: swap_usdc_to_sol
docs: Permissionless: convert the vault's ViaSol-bound pending USDC → wSOL.
Size derived on-chain; no-ops if nothing is pending.

accounts.name: signer
docs: Permissionless caller — any signer may run the conversion.

accounts.name: token_program_a
docs: Token program for mint A (owner of `token_mint_a`).

accounts.name: token_program_b
docs: Token program for mint B (owner of `token_mint_b`).

accounts.name: wsol_owner_account
docs: token_owner_account_a/_b actually holds wSOL, passed again here so the
handler can read its balance before/after without guessing which slot.

instructions.name: update_dex_twap
docs: Keeper-only: advance TWAP for one DEX-priced global asset without
minting shares. Never mint-path.
`twap_live_state` is written directly into `asset.twap.last_price_x64`
and stamps `last_update_twap_keeper_ts`.

accounts.name: payer
docs: Pays the transaction (client must set this as fee payer).

accounts.name: keeper
docs: Authorized TWAP keeper — signature / auth only; does not pay.

instructions.name: update_treasury_addr
docs: Update the program-wide treasury recipient address.

types.name: AssetAllocation
docs: One (asset, weight) pair a vault manager includes when creating a vault.
`asset_id` must reference an existing, `active` `AssetInfo` PDA (checked
against `remaining_accounts` in `create_etf`). All other asset config
(mint, pool, pricing, route, swap venue) lives on that shared `AssetInfo`
— not supplied here.

types.name: AssetInfo
docs: Admin-managed global asset listing. One PDA per asset
(`[ASSET_SEED, asset_id.to_le_bytes()]`), shared across every vault that
references it via `Vault.asset_ids[]`. Vault-specific weighting
(`allocation_bps`) lives on `Vault`, not here.

fields.name: asset_id
docs: Global id assigned at creation (== GlobalState.total_assets at the
time of creation). Part of this account's PDA seeds.

fields.name: mint
docs: SPL mint of this asset.

fields.name: pool_address
docs: Orca Whirlpool or DAMM v2 pool used to SWAP this asset (see `swap_kind`).
- `DirectUsdc`: this pool is USDC ↔ Asset
- `ViaSol`:     this pool is wSOL ↔ Asset  (USDC→wSOL uses `Vault.usdc_sol_pool`)

fields.name: pyth_feed_id
docs: Pyth price feed ID (32-byte hex) for this asset quoted in USD.
Meaningful only when `price_source_tag == PRICE_SOURCE_PYTH`.

fields.name: decimals
docs: Token decimals — cached at `create_asset` time to avoid mint account
reads in hot paths.

fields.name: route
docs: Routing strategy for USDC ↔ Asset swaps.

fields.name: price_source_tag
docs: Where this asset's USD price comes from: `0 = Pyth`, `1 = Dex`.
Flat POD tag — **not** a nested `PriceSource` enum on-account.

fields.name: price_dex_kind
docs: `DexKind` as `u8` when `price_source_tag == PRICE_SOURCE_DEX`; ignored for Pyth.

fields.name: price_pool_address
docs: The DEX pool `sum_nav` reads for pricing when `price_source_tag` is Dex.
May differ from `pool_address` (the SWAP pool) when this asset's price
venue and swap venue diverge — see `swap_kind`.
Quote leg depends on `route`:
- `DirectUsdc` → `USDC_MINT` (peg $1, no Pyth)
- `ViaSol`     → `WSOL_MINT`, then × Pyth SOL/USD (`SOL_USD_PYTH_FEED_ID`)

fields.name: twap
docs: Self-maintained on-chain TWAP state for this asset, shared globally
across every vault referencing it. Only advances when
`price_source_tag` is Dex and a deposit/redeem/keeper call touches
this asset; unused (all-zero) for Pyth-priced assets.

fields.name: swap_kind
docs: Which DEX venue SWAPS through `pool_address`. Independent of
`price_source_tag` — an asset can be priced via one venue and swapped
through the other if that's where its tradeable liquidity actually is.

fields.name: token_program_tag
docs: Token program for this asset's mint / vault ATAs:
`0 = classic SPL Token`, `1 = Token-2022`.

fields.name: active
docs: Admin-controlled listing status. `false` blocks this asset from
*new* `create_etf` calls only — vaults already referencing it are
unaffected.

fields.name: bump
docs: Stored PDA bump for this `AssetInfo` account.

types.name: CreateAssetParams
docs: Admin-supplied config for listing a new global asset via `create_asset`.
`decimals` is intentionally absent — read from the passed mint account
inside the handler, not caller-supplied.

fields.name: price_source_tag
docs: `0 = Pyth`, `1 = Dex`.

fields.name: price_dex_kind
docs: `DexKind` as `u8` when `price_source_tag == 1`; ignored for Pyth.

fields.name: token_program_tag
docs: `0 = classic SPL Token`, `1 = Token-2022`.

types.name: DexKind
docs: Which DEX venue a DEX-priced asset or swap route refers to.
Stored as `u8` on-account via `price_dex_kind` / as this enum for `swap_kind`.

types.name: FundType
docs: Whether the vault's asset basket is frozen at creation or can grow over time.
- `Fixed`   — asset count is locked at init; `Vault.max_assets` sets the cap.
- `Dynamic` — new assets can be added on the fly; `Vault.max_assets` is ignored.

types.name: GlobalState
docs: Global configuration and counters shared across all vault instances.

fields.name: total_assets
docs: Global asset counter — next `create_asset` call is assigned this id,
then it increments. Mirrors `total_vaults`'s role for `create_etf`.

fields.name: fee_recipient
docs: Pubkey that receives the vault manager's 80% share of deposit/redeem
fees. When `None`, defaults to the transaction signer at creation time.

fields.name: deposit_fee_bps
docs: Flat deposit fee in basis points. `0..=MAX_DEPOSIT_FEE_BPS`; `0` is valid.

fields.name: redeem_fee_bps
docs: Flat redeem fee in basis points. `MIN_REDEEM_FEE_BPS..=MAX_REDEEM_FEE_BPS`; mandatory.

fields.name: usdc_sol_pool
docs: Orca Whirlpool USDC↔wSOL first hop; None when all assets use DirectUsdc.

fields.name: assets
docs: 1–MAX_ASSETS entries, each referencing an existing admin-approved
`AssetInfo`; allocation_bps must sum to 10_000.

fields.name: fund_type
docs: Fixed or dynamic basket; defaults to Dynamic if omitted.

fields.name: max_shares
docs: Max outstanding shares; required for Fixed, ignored for Dynamic.

fields.name: total_nav
docs: Total portfolio value in USDC (6 decimals).

fields.name: share_price
docs: Current share price (PRICE_SCALE = 1e9 denominator).

fields.name: total_shares
docs: Outstanding shares at time of query.

types.name: PoolRoute
docs: How USDC reaches a particular asset inside the vault.
- `DirectUsdc` — single Whirlpool hop: USDC ↔ Asset
- `ViaSol`     — two-hop: USDC → wSOL (via `Vault.usdc_sol_pool`),
then wSOL → Asset (via `AssetInfo.pool_address`)

fields.name: shares_to_mint
docs: Shares the user would receive for `usdc_amount` (same math as `deposit`).

fields.name: total_nav
docs: Live NAV used for the quote (USDC, 6 decimals). 0 at genesis.

fields.name: share_price
docs: Share price implied by the live NAV (PRICE_SCALE = 1e9 denominator).

fields.name: total_shares
docs: Outstanding shares at time of quote.

fields.name: company_fee
docs: Company's 20% slice of the flat deposit fee.

fields.name: manager_fee
docs: Vault manager's 80% slice of the flat deposit fee.

fields.name: net_usdc
docs: `usdc_amount` after the flat deposit fee — this is what shares are priced against.

fields.name: num_assets
docs: Number of active assets in `asset_amounts`.

fields.name: asset_amounts
docs: Proportional token amounts the user would be owed, indexed to match
`Vault.assets[0..num_assets]`. Unused slots are zero.

fields.name: estimated_usdc_value
docs: Oracle-priced USDC value of those assets (6 decimals) — gross, before
the redeem fee, i.e. what the redeemed basket is worth right now.

fields.name: total_shares
docs: Outstanding shares at time of quote.

fields.name: company_fee
docs: Company's 20% slice of the flat redeem fee (estimate — real swaps
haven't run yet, so the real fee at claim time may differ slightly
due to oracle moves / slippage changing the realized gross amount).

fields.name: manager_fee
docs: Vault manager's 80% slice of the flat redeem fee (estimate).

fields.name: estimated_net_usdc
docs: Estimate of what `claim` would actually pay out to the user, i.e.
`estimated_usdc_value - company_fee - manager_fee`.

fields.name: redeemable_shares
docs: Shares burned at request time; 0 means no active redeem.

fields.name: unlock_time
docs: Unix timestamp — swap / claim are blocked before this.

fields.name: pending_usdc
docs: Running total of net USDC accumulated across all per-asset swaps.
Incremented each time an asset is swapped; `claim` transfers this amount.

fields.name: num_assets
docs: Number of active asset slots at request time — how many entries of
`asset_amount_in` / `asset_swapped` / `asset_usdc_out` are meaningful.

fields.name: asset_amount_in
docs: Per-asset input amount (native token units) the redeemer must swap,
snapshotted at `request_redeem` time as the user's proportional slice of
the pool: `floor(pool_balance[i] × shares / total_shares)`.
Indexed to match `Vault.assets[i]`. The per-asset swap instructions read
directly from this array instead of re-deriving the proportion.

fields.name: asset_swapped
docs: Per-asset swap completion flag (indexed by `AssetInfo` slot).
`true` once asset[i] has been fully swapped to USDC; prevents re-swapping.

fields.name: asset_to_sol_done
docs: `true` once ViaSol leg-1 (`swap_asset_to_sol`) has run for asset[i];
prevents replaying the asset→wSOL swap before leg-2 sets `asset_swapped`.

fields.name: asset_usdc_out
docs: Gross USDC received from each per-asset swap (no fee deducted at this
step anymore — the vault/performance fee is now computed once, at
claim time, on the redemption's total). Slot [i] is only meaningful
when `asset_swapped[i] == true`.

types.name: TwapState
docs: Self-maintained cumulative-price TWAP for one DEX-priced asset.
Sampled whenever a vault instruction already touches this asset's price
(deposit, redeem — never nav_view/preview, which discard their mutation).
No permissionless crank exists; the per-observation move cap
(`MAX_TWAP_MOVE_BPS`) is what stops a single attacker-triggered sample
after a quiet period from dominating the accumulated average.
Lives inline on the global `AssetInfo` PDA (plain Borsh `#[account]`,
not zero_copy) — mutated on every deposit/redeem touching a DEX-priced
asset, which pays full Borsh (de)serialization of `AssetInfo` per
mutation. Accepted trade-off: `AssetInfo` is small and this isn't the
hottest path in the program.

fields.name: cumulative_price
docs: Σ (price_x64 × seconds_elapsed) since asset listing (never reset;
the window is derived by subtracting `window_start_cumulative`).

fields.name: window_start_cumulative
docs: Snapshot of `cumulative_price` as of `window_start_ts` — the start of
the current rolling window. Advanced together with `window_start_ts`
each time the window rolls in `record_observation`.

fields.name: last_price_x64
docs: Last recorded (post-clamp) price observation, Q64.64 fixed point.

types.name: UserInfo
docs: NAV -> TOKEN PRICE
ENTRY PRICE -> ALICE JAN -> DEPOSIT 100 USDC of  10 AIVT  -> TOKEN PRICE  / NAV of 1000$ ->  FIRST ENTRY 1000 $ Stored
FEB -> 5 AIVT sellout but she took 15 extra aivt buy.

fields.name: total_usdc_deposited
docs: Net USDC deposited through this program, tracked for
`InsufficientTrackedBasis` guard purposes only (see `shares_held`
below) — no longer feeds any fee calculation.

fields.name: shares_held
docs: Shares minted to this user via THIS program's deposit instruction and
not yet redeemed through THIS program's request_redeem. Shares
acquired by transfer are not reflected here — see
`VaultError::InsufficientTrackedBasis`.

types.name: Vault
docs: Vault state mapped in-place via `AccountLoader` (damm-v2 zero_copy pattern).
Layout is POD-only: no nested `Option` / `bool` (those become flag `u8`s +
value fields). `INIT_SPACE` is locked to `size_of::<Vault>()` so account
allocation matches the on-wire `repr(C)` layout (including compiler padding).
Space at init: `8 + Vault::INIT_SPACE` (Anchor discriminator + body).

fields.name: vault_id
docs: Sequential global id assigned at creation (== GlobalState.total_vaults at
the time of creation). Part of every PDA seed for this vault.

fields.name: paused
docs: Deposit pause flag: `0 = live`, `1 = paused`. Use `is_paused` / `set_paused`.
Redemptions stay open regardless.

fields.name: admin_locked
docs: Admin emergency lock: `0 = unlocked`, `1 = locked`. Blocks deposits
only for this specific vault (independent of `paused`, which is the
vault_manager's own routine pause control). Redemptions always stay
open. Use `is_admin_locked` / `set_admin_locked`.

fields.name: deposit_fee_bps
docs: Flat fee charged on every deposit, before NAV pricing. `0` = no fee.
Bounds: `0..=MAX_DEPOSIT_FEE_BPS`. Immutable after `create_etf`.

fields.name: redeem_fee_bps
docs: Flat fee charged on every claim, off gross `pending_usdc`. Always > 0.
Bounds: `MIN_REDEEM_FEE_BPS..=MAX_REDEEM_FEE_BPS`. Immutable after `create_etf`.

fields.name: total_pending_usdc
docs: Total undeployed USDC owed to inflow swaps (Direct and ViaSol groups).

fields.name: total_pending_sol
docs: Total undeployed wSOL owed to ViaSol asset legs. Zero until the
USDC→wSOL hop runs.

fields.name: usdc_target_amount
docs: USDC pending per asset — DirectUsdc non-native and non-wSOL-native ViaSol
slots. Zero for USDC-native and wSOL-native slots.

fields.name: sol_target_bps
docs: Fixed ViaSol wSOL split in bps (sums to 10_000 across non-wSOL-native
ViaSol assets). Set once in `create_etf`; immutable after creation.

fields.name: max_shares
docs: Share supply cap. `0` = uncapped (Dynamic); `> 0` = Fixed cap.

fields.name: usdc_sol_pool_enabled
docs: `1` when `usdc_sol_pool` is set; `0` for USDC-only vaults.

fields.name: usdc_sol_pool
docs: Orca Whirlpool pool for USDC ↔ wSOL. Meaningful when `usdc_sol_pool_enabled != 0`.
Required when any asset uses `route == ViaSol`.

fields.name: num_assets
docs: Number of active asset slots (1–MAX_ASSETS).
Slots `[0..num_assets)` are active; remaining slots are zeroed.

fields.name: asset_ids
docs: Global asset ids this vault holds (indexes into the admin-managed
`AssetInfo` PDA registry, `[ASSET_SEED, id]`). Slot `i` here
corresponds to `asset_allocation_bps[i]`.

fields.name: asset_allocation_bps
docs: This vault's target weight (basis points) for `asset_ids[i]`.
Sum across active slots must equal 10_000. Vault-specific — the
shared `AssetInfo` registry entry has no allocation of its own.

fields.name: asset_ata_address
docs: Vault-authority ATA for each active asset slot (owner =
`vault_authority` PDA, mint = that asset's mint under its token
program). Derived once in `create_etf` and cached so deposit/redeem/
view hot paths compare against a stored key instead of re-deriving.
Slots `[num_assets..MAX_ASSETS)` stay `Pubkey::default()`.
